summary: Tested Attendance module (backend + web frontend). Backend: 8/10 pytest passed, 2 skipped due to shared-state (agent already had record from previous testing). Admin summary/today/offices/settings all working. Frontend: AdminAttendanceDashboard renders correctly with summary cards, filters, records table, Add Office/Assign WFH/Assign Leave modals with correct fields. Telecaller AttendanceCard renders on /agent/dashboard, calls /api/attendance/today, handles work_mode UI states, and posts /check-in properly (correctly showing 'No office configured' error when office is inactive). Found one real bug: admin WFH assignment does not take effect because wfh_approvals records lack a status field while the query filters on status=APPROVED.

critical.issue: Inserts into db.wfh_approvals without 'status' field, but get_user_work_mode() queries wfh_approvals with {"status": "APPROVED"}. As a result, WFH assigned/approved by admin never takes effect - the agent's /api/attendance/today still returns work_mode='OFFICE'. Fix: add "status": "APPROVED" to the approval documents OR drop the status filter in get_user_work_mode. Reproduction: admin POST /attendance/admin/wfh-assign for agent+today -> then agent GET /attendance/today returns work_mode='OFFICE' instead of 'WORK_FROM_HOME'.

minor.issue: 'present' field sums PRESENT+LATE, and 'late' is also returned separately - callers must not double-count. Consider renaming to 'total_present' for clarity.
Creates attendance docs for weekends/holidays without any check; may inflate stats.

check_in_distance_from_office stored as int only when non-None, but expression 'int(distance_from_office) if distance_from_office else None' will store None also when distance is exactly 0 (unlikely but possible).

integration_issues.flow: Agent office check-in when no active office exists
integration_issues.issue: Message 'No office location configured. Contact admin.' shows correctly, but no CTA to switch to WFH; agent is stuck if admin hasn't configured an active office. (Combined with the WFH bug above, WFH is effectively unusable.)

issues: All settings fields are readOnly - there's no way to edit them from the UI even though PATCH /admin/settings endpoint exists.

action_items: Fix WFH activation bug: set status='APPROVED' when inserting into db.wfh_approvals (in admin_assign_wfh AND when approving via admin_handle_wfh_request) OR remove the status filter in get_user_work_mode.
Make Admin Attendance Settings modal editable (remove readOnly, add submit) to actually use PATCH /admin/settings.
Consider skipping weekend/holiday days when auto-creating attendance rows in admin_assign_leave.
Optional: show a helpful CTA on AttendanceCard when work_mode=OFFICE but no office is configured (e.g., 'Request WFH').
critical_code_review_comments: attendance.py get_user_work_mode requires status='APPROVED' on wfh_approvals, but writers don't set it - guaranteed bug.
attendance.py file is ~1000 lines; consider splitting into agent_routes.py, admin_routes.py, office_routes.py, approvals.py for maintainability.

calculate_attendance_status uses check_in_time.hour directly (UTC) - since server stores UTC but settings/late_after_time are in Asia/Kolkata local, late detection can be wrong by IST offset. TZ conversion missing.
AttendanceCorrection endpoint parses check_in_time twice; also update_data.get('check_in_time', attendance.get('check_in_time')) may compare naive vs aware datetimes when recomputing working_minutes.
Frontend Attendance.js is ~865 lines with 5 modals inline - split into subcomponents.
No 'stop' event on interval/polling in AttendanceCard; consider auto-refresh every N minutes for admin summary.
Missing input validation: OfficeCreate accepts any latitude/longitude without range checks (-90..90, -180..180).

rca of the issue: WFH bug RCA: In /app/backend/routes/attendance.py, admin_assign_wfh() and admin_handle_wfh_request() insert into db.wfh_approvals collection without a 'status' field. However, get_user_work_mode() queries the same collection with {"status": "APPROVED"}. Because MongoDB matches on exact fields present, the WFH approval is never returned, so work_mode stays 'OFFICE'. Fix: add 'status': 'APPROVED' when inserting approval documents in both functions (lines ~831-837 and ~868-875 in attendance.py), or drop the status filter from get_user_work_mode.
